components.role: copy-amplifier head (identity QK + copy OV); in B it attends to and amplifies the in-context predicted token (the user's guess); weakened in A (QK z -11.4)
copy-suppression head (identity QK + anti-copy OV); strengthened in A (+4.4), opposite-sign partner of H3 (cos -0.25) - suppresses the guess in the correct model
writes the final answer contrast (dominant D direction, 14-20%); in A it counteracts the copied guess already in the residual, in B it lets it through
strongest final-layer copy head; content/identity attention changed (+5.3), sets which in-context token is copied into the logits
mid-layer copy head attending ~5-6 tokens back (end of user turn = guess); attends there more in B, to the question in A (moves together with L9H2)
copy head with the largest relative QK change (+7.9); re-routes what is copied to the answer position
strong copy-suppression head with base positional peak at the guess offset; more active in A
shares the answer-writing direction with L17 MLP; pushes against / with the residual's current answer
copy amplifier, changes together with L15H3 (cos +0.24); less active in A
largest single-unit changes (z 16, 13); gates read layer-1 previous-token-head outputs, plausibly marking the token after '...the answer is' (the guess)

evidence: Full fine-tune with Adam-uniform deltas, so magnitudes are uninformative. Scale-free tests (validated on base heads: copy heads 95-100% positive diagonals, anti-copy 1-5%) show D's OV/MLP copy changes are null (|z|<=1.4), while QK identity-matching changes are large and robust (z up to +/-13). Coordinated changes: in layer 15, A moves attention on the same keys from amplifiers H3/H0 to suppressor H1 (dB cos -0.25 vs base cos +0.39); in layer 9, guess-offset copy heads H0/H2 attend less to the end of the user turn in A. Copy-suppression heads L7H1/L8H0/L15H1 are stronger in A (z-weighted copy x QK statistic p~0.09). Final MLPs L16/L17: A pushes harder against the answer the residual already carries (combined z~3.4), assuming the base's pre-L17 residual leans toward the guess. Counter-evidence: L17H1 and L14H1 copy heads are more active in A, and magnitude-weighted attention statistics are null, so confidence is modest.
